settings.heading: Contact us
settings.lead: Questions about an order, which shade to pick, or a return? Email us at hello@velvetlengths.uk or send a message below, and we'll reply within 1–2 working days.
settings.after:
Matching a shade? Describe your natural colour, or tell us which two of our shades you're between, and we'll suggest the closest match.

Before you write, our delivery, returns and FAQs pages may already have the answer.
